mes-an-ni-pad-da.draftGloss: Mesannipadda (Langdon Mes-an-ni-pad-da) — first king of Ur; first sign DUB (Langdon: 'clearly DUP'), read mes

mes-ki-aĝ₂-{d}nanna.draftGloss: Meskiaĝnanna (Langdon Mes-ki-em-ᵈNannar) — king of Ur, son of Mesannipadda; mes (DUB) + ki-aĝ₂ 'love' (AĜ₂, Langdon em) + the moon-god Nanna (ŠEŠ.KI, Langdon Nannar)

e-lu-lu.draftGloss: Elulu — king of Ur (restored by Langdon from other copies)

ba-lu-lu.draftGloss: Balulu — king of Ur (restored by Langdon from other copies)

a-wa-an.draftGloss: Awan — a land to the east of Babylonia, toward Elam (A-PI-AN + place-det ki; PI read wa; Langdon A-wa-an)

ku-ul-[…].draftGloss: Kul… (Langdon Ku-ul (?)) — king of Awan; the second sign damaged, its reading uncertain; the rest lost

laḫ₄-[…].draftGloss: Laḫ… (Langdon Laḫ(?)) — first king of the second dynasty of Kish; first sign damaged, taken as LAḪ₄ (DU over DU); the rest lost

da-da-sig.draftGloss: Dadasig — king of Kish (second dynasty); DA-DA-SIG

ma₂-ma₂-gal-[…].draftGloss: Mamagal… (Langdon Má-má-gal) — king of Kish (second dynasty); written MA₂-MA₂-GAL, then a damaged sign and a break; in IV 27 the name of Kalbum's father is Má-gal-gal

ka-al-bu-um.draftGloss: Kalbum (Langdon Ka-al-bu-[um]) — king of Kish (second dynasty), son of Magalgal…

ma₂-gal-gal-[…].draftGloss: Magalgal… (Langdon Má-gal-gal) — father of Kalbum; MA₂-GAL-GAL, then a break; perhaps the Mamagal of IV 24, spelled differently

umuš-e.draftGloss: Umushe (Langdon Umuš-e) — king of Kish (second dynasty); first sign read umuš by Langdon (identification uncertain) + E

x-nun-na.draftGloss: …-nunna — king of Kish (second dynasty); the first sign is unread (Langdon '?', fn.: 'PISAN + RU ?')

i-bi-ni-iš.draftGloss: Ibinish (Langdon I-bi-ni-iš (?)) — king of Kish (second dynasty); an erased sign stands between bi and ni, and the last sign is damaged; reading uncertain

lugal-mu.draftGloss: Lugalmu (Langdon Lugal-mu, 'Lugalmu (?)') — last king of the second dynasty of Kish; lugal 'king' + mu (perhaps 'my')

ḫa-ma-zi.draftGloss: Hamazi (Langdon Ḫa-ma-ṣi) — a city or land, seat of a one-king dynasty; ḪA-MA-ZI (+ place-det ki); Langdon's ṣi is the ZI sign, read zi by sign

ḫa-da-ni-iš.draftGloss: Hadanish (Langdon Ḫa-da-ni-iš) — the one king of Hamazi
